{{Quote|These orbs contain white membrosia&mdash;rare nectar produced by our Givers. Pull back the wax and sip; you'll find it gives strength and healing.|[[Vector Hyllus]]|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Membrosia givers''', also known as '''Givers''', were a [[Killik/Legends|Killik]] variant whose sole existence was the production of [[Membrosia/Legends|membrosia]].

In [[35 ABY/Legends|35 ABY]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke]] and [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Skywalker]] encounter several membrosia givers in the [[Gorog]] nest inside [[Kr]], moon of [[Qoribu]]. Gorog Givers had abdomen size of bantha and speeder-sized head.
